# A text-only release change can still invalidate its keyed configuration

Removing the only nondefault project prefix leaves a default-only keyed map. The Bug records a decision-task validation error, followed by an exact backout and a separate replacement-message landing. Fixed config now has real project alternatives. Initial review approval and no application-runtime changes do not establish valid taskgraph generation. No taskgraph or email test ran.

Scope: Release notification keyed configuration.
